items.description: TDP (TP-Link Discovery Protocol) v2 UDP transport used by the app to find Tapo cameras on the LAN.

value.protocol: UDP, unbound ephemeral local port, SO_BROADCAST when broadcasting, SO_REUSEADDR
value.schedule_camera_scan: interval 90 ms, count = (total_ms*?)/90 per caller; some scans use per-send intervals [300,300,300,600,600] and end wait 3000 ms
value.desktop_recommendation: send the same request to 255.255.255.255:20002 and :20004 (and each interface's directed broadcast) about 8 times at 300 ms spacing, then listen ~1-3 s

items.description: TDP packet = 16-byte header + UTF-8 JSON payload. All multi-byte fields big-endian (sc1.a writes MSB first on little-endian hosts).

header_layout.name: flags
header_layout.value: 0x11 broadcast request (0x10|0x01); 0x21 unicast request (0x20|0x01). Bits: 0x01 REQUEST, 0x02 REPLY, 0x04 COMPRESS, 0x08 ENCRYPT, 0x10 BROADCAST, 0x20 UNICAST

value.checksum_algorithm: write 0x5A6B7C8D (1516993677) at offset 12, compute standard CRC-32 (zlib/IEEE) over header+payload, write result big-endian at offset 12

params.rsa_key: <PEM SubjectPublicKeyInfo of a fresh RSA-2048 key, lines of 64 chars, '\n' line ends, trailing '\n'>

value.rsa_key_generation: app-lifetime singleton KeyPairGenerator RSA 2048; PEM header '-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----' / footer '-----END PUBLIC KEY-----'

evidence.snippet: public c(byte b12, short s12, byte b13, String str, byte b14, b bVar)
new dn1.c(bL, dVar.f(), (byte) (i12 | 1), dVar.g(), dVar.i(), dVar.e());  // i12 = 16 bcast / 32 ucast

items.description: How replies are accepted.

steps: read 16-byte header (same layout), payload_length must be > 0
copy header+payload, overwrite bytes 12..15 with 0x5A6B7C8D, CRC32 must equal received checksum
serial must equal the request serial, version must equal request version, byte 7 must be 0 or 1
payload is UTF-8 JSON {"error_code":0,"result":{...}}; ignore if error_code != 0
multiple packets may be concatenated in one datagram buffer; advance 16+payload_length

items.description: How a cloud device is paired with a LAN-discovered camera.

value.key: lowercase hex MD5( cloud deviceId UTF-8 )
value.tdp_side: deviceIdMd5 = MD5(decrypted encrypt_info.device_id) or lowercase(top-level device_id) when not encrypted
value.rule: cloud device matches LAN device when MD5(cloud.deviceId) == tdp.deviceIdMd5. The app's device registry (TPIoTClientManager) and the TDP result map are both keyed by this MD5.
value.secondary_hint: MAC (cloud deviceMac vs TDP mac, both normalised to 12 uppercase hex) can be used as a fallback check (inferred; the code paths seen key on MD5)

DeviceInfoResult.alias has no Base64 adapter in this APK; some public clients report Base64 aliases from the legacy V1 getDeviceList. A client should try Base64-decode and keep the raw value if it does not decode to valid UTF-8.
Callers of w21.j pass (i12,i13,i14) totals at runtime; only the 90 ms interval and the 8x300 ms / 900 ms defaults are literal constants.
Server-side validation of platform/terminalName strings for non-Android clients is unknown; using Android-like values is the closest to app behaviour.
-23003 APP_VERSION_TOO_OLD threshold is server-side; send '3.22.806' or newer.
